installCommand: export PNPM_HOME=$PWD/.pnpm SHELL=/bin/bash && npx --yes get-pnpm 12.0.0 && $PNPM_HOME/bin/pnpm install --filter=examples-agent... --frozen-lockfile && $PNPM_HOME/bin/pnpm --workspace-root add --save-dev turbo@$(head -n 1 ../../version.txt) --config.minimum-release-age=0
buildCommand: cd ../.. && apps/factory/.pnpm/bin/pnpm --workspace-root exec turbo run build --filter={apps/factory}...
